title: What Proof-Carrying Code Systems Is
definition: Proof-Carrying Code Systems: code shipping with machine-checked proofs.
description:
Proof-Carrying Code Systems: code shipping with machine-checked proofs. This is Future Software Paradigms at its most ambitious — proof bundles research, code logistics engineering and proof checking operations converging on a single goal: making code hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Software Paradigms will decide trusted bases outcomes this century. Proof-Carrying Code Systems is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working code hulls, the larger proof bundles vision stalls, and with it, the code logistics systems that depend on it.

title: Real Research Today: Proof-Carrying Code Systems
definition: Today's documented research behind Proof-Carrying Code Systems.
description:
The road to Proof-Carrying Code Systems is already being paved. Program synthesis research (DeepMind AlphaCode, OpenAI Codex) generates code from natural language. Formal methods adoption grows in aerospace (NASA), chips (Intel/ARM) and crypto protocols.

Unikernel and library-OS research (MirageOS) rebuilds operating systems as composable libraries. Together these programs form the proof bundles foundation that Proof-Carrying Code Systems will build on — the code logistics results, the proof checking methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as code logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

Honest scoring is the point: a code hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Proof-Carrying Code Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Proof-Carrying Code Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Proof-Carrying Code Systems — code shipping with machine-checked proofs.

Phase 1 — Prove (proof bundles): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (code logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (proof checking): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (trusted bases): code hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and critical systems-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
